entries.brief: Owner-operated, voice-addressable real-life assistant HUD with no persistent chrome beyond search and movable canvases.
entries.audience: The owner during real voice-driven work
entries.use: Afon opens, moves, focuses, searches, explains, backgrounds, restores, and populates canvases
overrides: No navigation or footer by explicit owner requirement
Local IBM Plex instead of external Inter
Bounded spatial grid instead of horizontal dashboard scroll
entries.slop_test: Applicable gates 1-58 passed after rendered 320px and 1440px inspection; no marketing hero/nav/footer gates were activated.
